# EcomSathi — Full Documentation

> One Place for All Your Ecommerce Needs

EcomSathi is a free, browser-based ecommerce tools platform built for Indian sellers. All free tools work without login. No software installation required.

Website: https://ecomsathi.vercel.app
Contact: hello@ecomsathi.in

---

## FREE TOOLS

### SKU TOOLS

#### 1. SKU Generator
- URL: /tools/sku-generator
- Input: Product name, category, prefix, numbering start
- Output: SKU code (e.g. ELEC-LAMP-001)
- Use case: Create unique product identifiers for inventory and listings

#### 2. Bulk SKU Generator
- URL: /tools/bulk-sku
- Input: CSV file with product names, categories; or manual entry for multiple products
- Output: CSV file with generated SKU codes
- Use case: Generate SKUs for hundreds of products in one operation

#### 3. Barcode Generator
- URL: /tools/barcode
- Input: Product code or text, barcode type (EAN-13, Code 128, QR, UPC-A), size settings
- Output: PNG or SVG barcode image; printable label
- Use case: Print barcodes for physical product stickering

#### 4. SKU Label Printer
- URL: /tools/sku-label
- Input: SKU code, product name, price, barcode type, label dimensions
- Output: Printable label PDF (single or sheet)
- Use case: Print professional product stickers with barcode and SKU

#### 5. SKU Validator
- URL: /tools/sku-validator
- Input: CSV file or pasted list of SKU codes
- Output: Validation report — duplicates, invalid characters, length violations
- Use case: Audit existing SKU database before uploading to marketplace

#### 6. SKU to Barcode Converter
- URL: /tools/sku-to-barcode
- Input: SKU codes (manual or CSV), target barcode type
- Output: Barcode images (PNG/SVG) per SKU; downloadable ZIP
- Use case: Convert existing product SKUs to printable barcodes

#### 7. Bulk SKU to Barcode
- URL: /tools/sku-bulk-barcode
- Input: CSV with SKUs and product details, barcode type, label template
- Output: PDF sheets of barcode labels ready for printing
- Use case: Print an entire product catalogue's labels in one go

---

### PDF TOOLS

#### 1. PDF Merge
- URL: /tools/pdf-merge
- Input: 2–20 PDF files (max 50MB each)
- Output: Single merged PDF
- Processing: PDF-Lib in browser (no server upload for small files); Railway for large batches

#### 2. PDF Split
- URL: /tools/pdf-split
- Input: Single PDF, page ranges or "every page"
- Output: Individual PDF files (downloaded as ZIP if multiple)

#### 3. PDF Compress
- URL: /tools/pdf-compress
- Input: PDF file (up to 50MB)
- Output: Compressed PDF; shows original vs compressed size
- Processing: Ghostscript-equivalent via Railway backend

#### 4. PDF OCR
- URL: /tools/pdf-ocr
- Input: Scanned PDF or image PDF
- Output: Searchable PDF with embedded text layer; optionally plain text export
- Processing: Tesseract OCR on Railway; supports English, Hindi

#### 5. PDF Rotate
- URL: /tools/pdf-rotate
- Input: PDF; select pages and rotation angle (90°, 180°, 270°)
- Output: Rotated PDF

#### 6. PDF Watermark
- URL: /tools/pdf-watermark
- Input: PDF; watermark text or image; opacity, position, rotation settings
- Output: Watermarked PDF

#### 7. PDF to Image
- URL: /tools/pdf-to-image
- Input: PDF file, output format (PNG or JPG), resolution (72–300 DPI)
- Output: Image files (ZIP download if multiple pages)
- Processing: pdf2pic + Sharp on Railway

#### 8. Image to PDF
- URL: /tools/image-to-pdf
- Input: JPG, PNG, or WebP images (up to 20 per batch)
- Output: Single PDF with one image per page

#### 9. PDF Reorder Pages
- URL: /tools/pdf-reorder
- Input: PDF; drag-and-drop thumbnail reordering interface
- Output: PDF with pages in new order

#### 10. Extract PDF Pages
- URL: /tools/pdf-extract-pages
- Input: PDF; page selection (individual pages or ranges)
- Output: New PDF containing only selected pages

#### 11. Delete PDF Pages
- URL: /tools/pdf-delete-pages
- Input: PDF; page selection to remove
- Output: PDF with selected pages removed

#### 12. PDF Unlock
- URL: /tools/pdf-unlock
- Input: Password-protected PDF; password
- Output: Unlocked PDF (user must own the document)

#### 13. PDF Protect
- URL: /tools/pdf-protect
- Input: PDF; user password; owner password (optional); permissions (print, copy, edit)
- Output: Password-protected PDF

---

### IMAGE TOOLS

#### 1. Background Remover
- URL: /tools/background-remover
- Input: JPG or PNG product image (up to 20MB)
- Output: PNG with transparent background; optionally add white or coloured background
- Processing: AI background removal via Railway (ONNX model or rembg)
- Use case: Marketplace product photos require white background

#### 2. Product Image Optimizer
- URL: /tools/product-optimizer
- Input: Product images; target marketplace (Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho, etc.)
- Output: Resized and optimised images meeting marketplace spec (e.g. Amazon: 2000×2000px JPG < 10MB)
- Processing: Sharp on Railway

#### 3. Image Resize
- URL: /tools/image-resize
- Input: Image; target width and/or height in pixels; maintain aspect ratio toggle
- Output: Resized image in original format

#### 4. Image Compress
- URL: /tools/image-compress
- Input: JPG, PNG, or WebP; quality slider (1–100)
- Output: Compressed image; size comparison shown

#### 5. Image Format Converter
- URL: /tools/image-convert
- Input: Image in any format; target format (JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, BMP)
- Output: Converted image

#### 6. Image Crop
- URL: /tools/image-crop
- Input: Image; crop area (drag to select); or preset ratios (1:1, 4:3, 16:9)
- Output: Cropped image

#### 7. Image Watermark
- URL: /tools/image-watermark
- Input: Image; watermark text or logo PNG; position, opacity, size settings
- Output: Watermarked image

#### 8. Bulk Image Resize
- URL: /tools/image-bulk-resize
- Input: Multiple images (ZIP or individual); target dimensions
- Output: ZIP of resized images

#### 9. Background Colour Changer
- URL: /tools/image-background-colour
- Input: Image with transparent or removed background; target colour (hex, white, gradient)
- Output: Image with new background applied

#### 10. Flip and Rotate
- URL: /tools/image-flip-rotate
- Input: Image; flip direction (horizontal/vertical); rotation angle (custom degrees)
- Output: Transformed image

#### 11. Image Metadata Viewer
- URL: /tools/image-metadata
- Input: JPG, PNG, TIFF image
- Output: EXIF data table (camera, GPS, date, dimensions); option to strip metadata and download clean image

---

### VIDEO TOOLS

#### 1. Video to GIF
- URL: /tools/video-to-gif
- Input: MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM (up to 500MB); start/end time selection; FPS and size settings
- Output: Animated GIF
- Processing: FFmpeg on Railway
- Use case: Product showcase animations for marketplace listings

#### 2. Video Compress
- URL: /tools/video-compress
- Input: Video file; quality preset (high/medium/low) or CRF value
- Output: Compressed MP4; size comparison
- Processing: FFmpeg H.264 on Railway

#### 3. Video Resize
- URL: /tools/video-resize
- Input: Video file; target resolution (480p, 720p, 1080p or custom)
- Output: Resized video

#### 4. Video Trim
- URL: /tools/video-trim
- Input: Video file; start and end timestamps
- Output: Trimmed video clip

#### 5. Extract Frames
- URL: /tools/video-to-frames
- Input: Video file; frame interval (every N seconds) or specific timestamps
- Output: PNG images (ZIP download)
- Use case: Grab product thumbnail from a video

#### 6. GIF to Video
- URL: /tools/gif-to-video
- Input: Animated GIF
- Output: MP4 video

---

### LABEL CROP TOOL

- URL: /label-crop
- Input: PDF file containing shipping labels (from any supported marketplace)
- Supported marketplaces:
  - Amazon — detects label area, crops thermal-style label
  - Flipkart — standard label format with order and item details
  - Myntra — cropped from packing slip/label combo
  - Meesho — label extraction from bulk print PDF
  - AJIO — supply chain label format
  - Nykaa — B2C shipping label
  - Snapdeal — legacy format supported
- Output options: PNG per label, or compiled PDF with one label per page, or A4 sheet with 2/4 labels per page
- Processing: PDF.js (browser) for rendering; Sharp on Railway for cropping
- Use case: Sellers receive multi-page PDFs from marketplaces. This tool extracts and formats labels for printing on thermal or A4 printers.

---

### GST TOOLS

#### 1. GSTIN Search and Verification
- URL: /tools/gst-search
- Input: 15-digit GSTIN
- Output: Business name, legal name, address, registration date, filing status, taxpayer type
- Data source: GST portal API (real-time)

#### 2. GST Calculator
- URL: /tools/gst-calculator
- Input: Amount, GST rate (5%, 12%, 18%, 28%), inclusive or exclusive
- Output: Base amount, GST amount (CGST + SGST or IGST), final amount

#### 3. HSN / SAC Code Search
- URL: /tools/hsn-search
- Input: Product description or HSN code
- Output: Matching HSN codes, product description, applicable GST rate
- Data source: GST council HSN master database

#### 4. GST Return Filing Status Checker
- URL: /tools/gst-return-checker
- Input: GSTIN, financial year, return type (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B)
- Output: Filing status per period (filed / not filed / late filed)
- Use case: Verify supplier compliance before claiming input tax credit

#### 5. PAN Card Validator
- URL: /tools/pan-validator
- Input: 10-character PAN number
- Output: Format validity, PAN type (P=Individual, C=Company, H=HUF, F=Firm, etc.), name structure check

#### 6. TDS Calculator (Ecommerce)
- URL: /tools/tds-calculator
- Input: Gross sale amount, seller category (individual/company), marketplace
- Output: TDS deductible under Section 194-O, net payout amount
- Supports: Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho, Myntra

#### 7. GST Invoice Generator
- URL: /tools/invoice-generator
- Input: Seller GSTIN, buyer details, line items with HSN codes and quantities
- Output: PDF GST invoice conforming to CGST rules

#### 8. E-Way Bill Checker
- URL: /tools/eway-bill
- Input: Consignment value, transport mode, distance, goods type
- Output: Whether e-way bill is required; generation instructions

#### 9. Composition Scheme Calculator
- URL: /tools/composition-scheme
- Input: Business type, annual turnover, goods/services mix
- Output: Tax under composition scheme vs regular scheme comparison; eligibility check

#### 10. Reverse Charge Mechanism Calculator
- URL: /tools/reverse-charge
- Input: Service/goods type, supply details, supplier type (registered/unregistered)
- Output: Whether RCM applies, tax payable by recipient

---

## PREMIUM MODULES (Login Required)

### Ecommerce Reconciliation

Match marketplace settlement reports against order data to identify discrepancies.

Features:
- Upload settlement reports (CSV, Excel) from Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Meesho
- Automatic column mapping and data parsing
- Match orders to settlement lines by order ID
- Flag missing settlements (order shipped but no payment received)
- Flag incorrect deductions (commission, returns, penalties)
- Export reconciliation report as Excel
- Dashboard with summary stats: total orders, reconciled, pending, disputed

Supported reports:
- Amazon: Payment report, Order report
- Flipkart: Settlement statement, Returns report
- Myntra: Settlement file
- Meesho: Payment report

### Inventory Management

Track product stock across multiple warehouses and channels.

Features:
- Product master — SKU, name, category, HSN code, dimensions, weight
- Variant support — size, colour combinations with individual SKUs
- Multi-warehouse stock levels (own warehouse, 3PL, marketplace FBA/FBS)
- Purchase order management — raise PO, receive goods, update stock
- Stock movement history — every inbound and outbound tracked
- Low stock alerts — configurable minimum stock thresholds
- Stock valuation — weighted average cost method
- Export stock report to Excel
- Bulk product import via CSV

---

## PROCESSING ARCHITECTURE

### File Flow for Large Files
1. User selects file in browser
2. Browser uploads directly to Supabase Storage (bypasses Railway)
3. Frontend sends storage path to Railway processing API
4. Railway downloads file from Supabase, processes (FFmpeg/Sharp/Tesseract)
5. Railway uploads result to Supabase Storage
6. Frontend fetches signed download URL from Supabase
7. User downloads processed file

This keeps Railway memory low and leverages Supabase CDN for delivery.

### Small File Processing (PDF, Image < 5MB)
Processed entirely in the browser using:
- PDF-Lib (PDF manipulation)
- pdf.js (PDF rendering)
- Canvas API (image operations)
- WASM modules for OCR (Tesseract.js)

---

## DATA PRIVACY

- Files are deleted from Supabase Storage within 1 hour of processing
- Anonymous use is allowed for all free tools (no account required)
- File contents are never logged or stored in any database
- No personal data is collected during free tool use
- Premium modules require account but only store metadata, not file contents

---

## API / INTEGRATION

EcomSathi does not currently offer a public API. All tools are web-only.
